payload.title: install --plugin is ignored by the cratylus command
payload.body: Ruled: remove --plugin from install and its help. Installing another corpus already has its path, a cratylus.config.ts that the corpus-authoring commands read; a flag that does nothing breaks the command line's no-footguns clause, and making it work would give install a second way to choose a corpus. For the next plan under command line.
